states.name: The Queen of Hearts
states.title: Crimson Arbiter
states.description:
She is the beautiful yet terrifying queen who reigns over her dream world from the Castle of Hearts.
Reason and morality has no place in her court. Guilt, punishment, and even the law itself are decided by her word alone. None dare defy her as she delivers her absurd decrees with an elegant smile.

states.name: The Queen of Hearts
states.title: Crimson Arbiter
states.description:
The Queen of Hearts is rather particular when it comes to preparing for a tea party.
Everything must be just right—the temperature of the tea, the arrangement of the candies, the aroma of pomegranate pastries. She claims it is all to guarantee the delight of her guests, yet at times, her gaze makes it seem as though she is waiting for someone who is no longer there.

states.name: The Queen of Hearts
states.title: Crimson Arbiter
states.description:
"A gentle lie is better than a cruel reality."

For the longest time, that was the one thing the Queen believed in. No matter how many times she rewound the world or stained her hands with crimson, she believed that her wish to protect would never falter. But in the end, she learned that love means not only holding someone close, but also knowing when to let them go.
